localChecks.limitation: These checks are not the canonical schema/registry validator and do not establish canonical acceptance.

canonicalValidation.reason: Previously reported execution host failed before process creation; qualified paired inputs unavailable. No new canonical attempt in this preparation.

preservedBoundaries.net50Net80Study: Separate same-entry net-50 primary/net-80 secondary exit study remains unchanged; this candidate-window experiment is not equivalent to it.

unconsumedMetadata.warning: Public-example metadata only; not verified H hold policy, not permission to outlive mandatory closes; do not route to persistDotExitComparison.

preconditions: Run canonical validator against pinned source and exact proposal bytes; retain actual acceptance or rejection and canonical hash.
Use identical point-in-time input, routing snapshot/timestamp, source evidence IDs, contract chain, ownership/event state and feature evidence in both arms; record matching canonical input hashes.
Control uses canonical 2-5 DTE strategy under a distinct research version; challenger is this unchanged 3-5 DTE proposal. Both arms remain research-only.
assertions: Include eligible contracts at DTE 2,3,4,5 and out-of-window boundaries 1,6. Assert challenger accepted IDs equal baseline accepted IDs intersected with DTE 3-5.

For each retained DTE 3-5 contract compare full candidate economics, quantity and eligibility/gate outputs exactly; permit only explicitly documented proposal/receipt identity fields to differ. Do not infer quantity when absent from output.

Record every baseline-eligible DTE 2 opportunity removed, with original identity, economics, quantity if present and challenger rejection reason. Report pre-existing rejections separately; do not count them as coverage loss.
Neither arm may admit DTE 1 or 6. Registry baseline hash and its 2-5 lattice must remain unchanged before and after.

Negative admission cases must stay rejected/blocked by existing gates in both arms: unknown required metadata/multiplier, stale executable quote, routing/decision time mismatch, missing source evidence IDs, missing chain and ineligible router. Verify concrete fixture coverage and actual reasons; do not invent rejection codes.

Use separate existing rule-bearing fixtures for missing, unqualified, null, stale, future, wrong-snapshot and unbound feature evidence, plus duplicate-feature rejection. The proposal itself has no research rules: unused feature staleness is not a blanket rejection condition.
Unknown baseline, unsupported model references, DTE expansion and changed hard-risk boundaries must fail validation or block evaluation as specified by existing admission logic; no bypasses.
No order intent, broker authority, execution enablement, mandatory-close changes or roll action. Consumer receipt must remain modeled research with profitability empirically unproven.
pairedCoveragePlan.interpretation: Coverage/invariance testing only. Even a future synthetic test pass is not market evidence, after-cost expectancy, or an out-of-sample result.
